title: Sentinel Decision Packet
description: Static shape for a human-approval record binding to a concrete proposed operation. Descriptive only -- no runtime approval execution consumes this schema in S1. Tightened in S1 remediation cycle 1 (S1-F006): exact-payload vs. hashed-payload are now mutually exclusive with a declared hash algorithm, decision metadata is conditionally required once a decision is made, and evidence binding scales with declared risk.

payload_hash_algorithm.description: Required whenever payload_hash is present (S1-F006) -- a hash with no declared algorithm cannot be independently verified.

idempotency_key.description: Optional in S1 -- no runtime execution exists yet for this to prevent double-execution against. Becomes meaningful once execution is automated in a later, separately authorized phase.

allOf.description: S1-F006: payload (exact) and payload_hash (hashed) are mutually exclusive -- a packet binds to exactly one representation, never both and never neither.

S1-F006: once a decision is made (APPROVED/REJECTED), decided_at is required. While PENDING, decided_at must be absent, not null (JSON has no meaningful 'null timestamp'; omission is the honest representation of 'not yet decided').

S1-F006: high/highest-risk decisions must bind to at least one piece of evidence -- evidence binding is part of the adopted Decision Packet requirement (D-012), not optional at the top of the risk scale.
